title: Massive MSFS Marketplace Update! New Australia Tour, Epic Landings & Realism Missions
description:
The weekly Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace update is here, and this time we are diving deep into a major milestone release: the "United Springs 2026" mission pack by Perfect Flight, alongside massive new commercial schedules and scenic excursions.

Designed with cross-platform versatility, this package introduces 12 ultra-realistic, highly structured IFR commercial airline missions across the United States. For MSFS 2020 pilots, you will be commanding the high-fidelity Airbus A320neo, while MSFS 2024 pilots will take the reins of the Boeing 737 Max. This pack tests your skills along iconic domestic networks, trans-continental operations, Gulf Coast transitions, Great Basin crossings, and technically demanding Northeast precision approaches.

Aside from the structured mission engine—featuring over 100 random real-world events and authentic aviation sounds—this update delivers massive landing challenge overhauls for Australia and New Zealand, fresh commercial timetables from VA Systems (covering Swiss, TAP, and more), and the next chapters of Koshi's massive Australian Discovery Tour utilizing the new World Update 21 assets. In this video, we break down exactly what you get inside the marketplace, check out third-party compatibility with SimBrief and Navigraph, and analyze whether these packages are worth your hard-earned money.

✈️ What do you think? Are you planning to pick up this United mission pack or Koshi's Australian tour from the Marketplace, or will you stick to downloading free add-ons from community sites? Let me know your thoughts in the comment section below!

Don't forget to like, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
